research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01. Frozen two occupations preserved and expanded into team contracts, interrupted playing periods, conservation initiatives, corporate governance, study and authorship. No full-time years calculable. Unknown paid status and hours retained rather than zero.

Follow-up: Force apprentice/senior agreements, Brumbies/ARU and Panasonic legal employers, historical ownership/control, contracted hours, exact starts/ends, injury leave 2013–14, 2017 sabbatical pay and resumed contracts. Overlapping national and club contracts must be unioned, not added. Confirm March/May/October 2020 distinctions before any endpoint calculation.

Follow-up: identify July 2020–December 2021 Project Director employer from original CV or project annual reports; determine whether Rangelands operational work was paid and full-time, distinct from founder/governance role. A newspaper characterisation of full-time conservation does not identify salaried employment or its dates.

Follow-up: business/directorship histories, contracting and ambassador income, authorship terms, charity operating roles and any earlier jobs. Secondary interest-register aggregators identify DP Independent Pty Ltd and 2026 book-advance leads; primary corroboration still needed, not silently treated as jobs.

Searched own/parliamentary biographies, rugby employers and player association profiles, contract announcements, retirement/sabbatical reporting, Brumbies 2016 historical annual report, organisation team pages, public professional-profile and register searches, CSU graduation programme. Sports full-time match labels and another player’s full-time study are not employment evidence. People-data broker result not used.

Individual source gaps: APH direct access robots-blocked; Classic Wallabies and Western Force direct open (403) Forbidden, indexed primary evidence used where identified. Brumbies report target text retrieval did not establish historical legal control. No access controls bypassed. Follow-up remains required, blocked is not completion.

Follow-up2026-10-02: identified US Rangelands nonprofit tax-return officer record with reported zero2022compensation, separating governance from unidentified earlier Project Director employment. Matching team names and own Rangelands history support identity. Do not extrapolate to Zimbabwe payroll or earlier years.

Full tax-return iframe returned non-retryable500redirect to inaccessible rendered file; XML403. Only accessible ProPublica IRS-data summary used; hours and precise role boundaries remain unknown. No jobwide blocker. Ebook page establishes proceeds destination for current offer, not universal zero author income.

Targeted project-director employer and rugby full-time/sabbatical searches did not establish contracts, actual hours, legal sporting employers or March/May/October2020endpoint reconciliation. Future primary leads: US2021/2022full officer schedules, Zimbabwe project payroll/annual reports, signed rugby agreements or employer announcements detailing leave; no inferred zero employment.
